## Review and checklist

<!-- Summarize self-review findings and unresolved risks. Check only completed items. Explain inapplicable items. -->

- [ ] Branch and PR title follow repository conventions
- [ ] Low-level design, impacted areas, and rollout reviewed
- [ ] Lint, formatting, type checks, and applicable tests passed locally
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests and agent changes have evals, where applicable
- [ ] ADR, docs, and configuration examples are current, where applicable
- [ ] No secrets in the diff and safety controls verified where affected
- [ ] Required CI checks passed for the current head
- [ ] GitHub assignee verified
